definition: SAS Viya is an artificial intelligence, analytics and data management platform developed by SAS Institute.
details: SAS Viya is an artificial intelligence, analytics and data management platform developed by SAS Institute.

explainer.lead: SAS Viya is an analytics, AI and data management platform from SAS Institute, aimed at organisations that want to run modelling and data work on one managed system. It matters because it lets enterprises build and deploy analytics on a common platform rather than stitching together separate tools.

tiers.eli5: It's like a big workbench where a company keeps all its data and tools for analysing it in one place, instead of scattering them across different rooms.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it to manage data, train models and put analytics results into production within one environment. A common pitfall is assuming a platform choice removes the need for careful data preparation and governance.
tiers.paperLevel: It is a commercial platform, not a single algorithm, so there is no formal definition or formula; its limits are those of the platform's supported data sources and deployment options.

explainer.example: A bank could load customer data into Viya, build a risk model there, and share the results with business teams without moving data between separate systems.
